missingCombinationsBatch.style: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: full-screen loading backdrop for Universal History Simulator. Make ONE complete wide 16:9 landscape image, opaque edge-to-edge, no border, no collage, no labels or UI. Style: richly detailed handcrafted pixel-art historical game background, clearly visible square pixel clusters, crisp stepped edges, restrained natural palette and layered atmospheric depth, matching the project's detailed landscapes. Neither photorealistic nor smooth digital painting, no blur. Composition: panoramic eye-level view; expressive skyline and environment in top 25%; small people doing everyday work and readable material details in bottom 30%; the middle 35% is mostly connecting landscape, paths or water because a horizontal interface covers it. Keep essential details away from extreme edges for responsive crop. People are modestly scaled within the landscape, natural proportions, historically plausible clothes and tools. Show a believable inhabited place, not a montage of landmarks. No text, logos, watermark, fantasy, modern items unless the scene calls for them. The specified region and date RANGE guides a reusable typical scene, not an exact historical event or famous place. Keep foreground faces and the main handwork in the lowest quarter of the image, preferably seated or kneeling figures near the lower corners. Do not center a large standing person whose face would be hidden by the interface. Avoid imposing famous landmarks or period costumes that make the scene belong to only one city or dynasty.

scenes.central-asian-frontier: Northern Central Asian steppe frontier settlements, 1700–1899 CE. A modest river trading town at the meeting of open golden grassland and low Altai foothills; low timber cottages with plank roofs intermixed with plain earthen courtyard walls, a few poplars near water, no monumental skyline. A small horse and mule cart by wool sacks, people in practical long coats and felt caps checking harness and sorting trade bundles in bottom corners. Dry cool continental summer, blue-gray distant mountains and huge sky. Reusable for eastern Kazakhstan and southern western Siberia, including Öskemen. No South Asian temples, palms, minarets dominating, modern railways, asphalt or cars.
scenes.eurasian-steppe-pastoral: Central Eurasian grassland pastoral communities, 1000 BCE–1899 CE, showing durable everyday practices rather than a dynasty. Broad treeless rolling steppe and a stream; small round felt-covered dwellings with low conical roofs, sheep and horses scattered nearby, a few plain pack bundles. In bottom corners, seated adults in simple wool tunics and felt caps repair leather tack and fold felt beside a basket; another tends sheep. Distant low mountains and vast clouded sky. No towns, religious monuments, guns, flags, armor, modern equipment, ornate later court costume or horse stirrups shown close-up. Natural pale grasses, earth and muted felt colors.
scenes.tibetan-highlands-later: Tibetan plateau and trans-Himalayan highland communities, 1200–1899 CE. An inhabited high dry mountain valley with terraced small barley plots, stone irrigation channels, clusters of flat-roofed stone and earth houses with dark timber window frames, snow streaks high on remote ridges. Foreground bottom corners: bundled highland residents in plain wool wrap robes tending a shaggy yak pack animal and sorting barley in a broad wooden tray. Windy clear cool light, ocher rock, pale sky and small green irrigated patches. No Hindu temple towers, rice paddies, lowland tropical plants, giant famous palace or modern roads.
scenes.eastern-europe-timber-settlements: Eastern European forest and forest-steppe settlements, 1000–1899 CE, a reusable vernacular small settlement without date-specific state monuments. Rolling meadows and birch/pine woods, a winding river and clusters of modest hewn-log cottages with timber or thatched pitched roofs, simple fences and kitchen gardens. Bottom corners show residents in plain linen and wool rural clothing splitting firewood, weaving a basket and loading hay onto a plain wooden cart. A dirt lane leads through the settlement; inhabited working landscape with no dominant church. No onion-dome fantasy skyline, factories, electric wires, firearms, armor, modern tools or national flags.
scenes.south-asia-foraging-communities: Prehistoric South Asian foraging communities, 13000–3500 BCE, upland woodland and seasonal river environments. Rocky low hills frame a shallow stream with tall dry grasses and mixed broadleaf woodland, small temporary brush-and-branch shelters and a natural rock overhang. Bottom corners show small groups of people in simple draped plant-fiber and hide coverings sorting wild tubers, nuts and gathered seed heads, making cordage and using a chipped-stone tool near woven carrying baskets. No agriculture, pottery display, domesticated cattle, horses, chickens, metal, permanent towns, monuments or temple architecture. Warm late-afternoon earth colors, quietly detailed pixel clusters.
scenes.southeast-asia-early-farming: Early farming communities of mainland and island Southeast Asian lowlands, 3500 BCE–500 CE. A broad humid river edge and a modest village of bamboo and timber houses raised on short posts, steep plain thatched roofs, small mixed gardens, wooded low hills and wet cultivated patches. Bottom foreground seated people in simple woven wrap clothing sort rice panicles into baskets, mend a fishing net and shape plain earthenware by hand; a small dugout canoe rests at muddy bank. Broad reusable early village scene; no monumental temples, Chinese city gates, glazed palace roofs, metal machinery, New World maize, tomatoes, chili peppers, horses or ornate royal costume.
scenes.north-china-late-imperial: Northern Chinese and southern Manchurian settled communities, 1400–1899 CE. A modest village market lane with gray brick and rammed-earth courtyard houses, plain gently pitched gray-tile roofs, a few poplars and dry millet fields, loess-colored low hills beyond. Bottom corners show residents in plain cotton jackets and trousers sorting grain into woven baskets, mending a wooden cart and weighing vegetables beside ceramic storage jars. Dusty golden late-summer daylight with cool blue distance. Reusable regional vernacular, no iconic palace, dynasty-specific imperial hats, close-up distinctive hairstyles, great wall, electric wires, factories, cars, rice terraces, pagoda forest or Japanese torii.
scenes.east-africa-highlands-later: Ethiopian and East African highland farming settlements, 1200–1899 CE. Broad cultivated highland slopes, dark volcanic soil, small grain fields and grazing patches, modest round earthen and stone houses with tall conical thatch roofs clustered behind low stone walls. Bottom corners show residents in simple woven cloth wraps and shawls winnowing grain in a shallow basket, carrying a water jar and tending a pack donkey. A few indigenous highland trees, dramatic cloudy sky and blue plateau ridges, cool green and gold landscape. No Middle Eastern desert city, mosque skyline, palms, tropical beach, maize, eucalyptus, colonial uniforms or modern roads.
scenes.latin-america-early-twentieth-town: Latin American towns, 1900–1969 CE, a broad small-town streetscape combining continuity of vernacular architecture with everyday twentieth-century life. One- and two-story stucco and adobe buildings with plain tile roofs and shaded arcades, a modest open market square, distant low green hills, simple early utility poles and one restrained 1930s-style truck far in middle distance. Foreground bottom corners residents in ordinary shirts, skirts, trousers and modest hats sort produce into wooden crates and repair a bicycle beside a market stall. No US Main Street, New York skyline, Wild West saloon, giant monuments, national flags, text, skyscrapers or late-model cars.
scenes.northwest-south-asia-later-towns: Northwestern South Asian inland towns, 1500–1899 CE, broadly Punjab, Sindh and adjoining plains. A lived-in bazaar lane with low brick and earth courtyard houses, shaded wooden shopfronts, flat roofs and some plain small rounded arches; a restrained distant dome above rooftops, dry plains and a canal with trees beyond. Bottom corners: residents wearing simple long tunics, loose trousers, shawls and varied plain headwraps sit sorting grain and folded cloth, repairing a pack saddle beside a small donkey. Warm dusty daylight, brick ocher and indigo cloth. No South Indian gopuram towers, giant imperial landmarks, fantasy exoticism, modern machinery, electric wires or military uniforms.

selectionBasis.method: Replay the existing sample of randomStartFromDraws settings against the current backdrop selector; prioritize cross-region/cross-era fallback mismatches. Oskemen 1847 is an explicit regression case. New ranges remain broad, with climate, terrain and settlement guards.

scenes.europe-glacial: Southwestern and central European open valleys, 30,000–10,000 BCE. Cool late-glacial steppe beside limestone escarpments, sparse birch, distant reindeer. Small hide tents and a rock overhang; foreground people sewing hides and knapping stone beside a modest hearth. Cold blue sky with soft cloud, ochre grasses, a trace of snow on high ground. No farming, pottery, settled villages, boats or medieval buildings.
scenes.africa-deep-prehistory: Eastern and southern African foraging landscapes, 80,000–10,000 BCE. Freshwater lake, reeds, broad volcanic ridges and open grassland with scattered acacias. Foreground small mobile camp, people knapping stone and preparing gathered food beside modest brush shelters, gathering baskets and wooden implements. Warm earth colors, storm clouds gathering over distant hills. No agriculture, metal, herded cattle, permanent town or spear battle.
scenes.sahara-green: Central and eastern Saharan pastoral landscapes, 6000–3500 BCE. A green savanna lake beneath dramatic sandstone escarpments, grasslands and acacias, cattle drinking in shallows. Foreground pastoral households with simple reed and hide shelters, pots, baskets, people tending cattle and preparing food. Fresh dawn green-gold palette, broad blue water. No camels, pyramids, modern houses or current arid desert.
scenes.levant-foragers: Levantine settled foragers, 13,000–9500 BCE. Limestone foothills, scattered oaks, seasonal stream and stands of wild cereals. A small cluster of low round dwellings with stone footings and brush roofs beside a rock overhang, foreground grinding stones, baskets and people gathering and processing wild grain. Soft clear spring morning. No domestic livestock, pottery, metal, formal farmland or later mudbrick town.
scenes.east-asia-neolithic: Northern Chinese millet-farming villages, 6000–3000 BCE. Loess slopes and broad river, millet gardens, a cluster of low semi-subterranean earthen houses with conical thatch roofs. Foreground villagers carrying harvest baskets and making painted earthenware pots beside outdoor hearths. Rust, straw, muted green and blue palette, late summer sun. No pagodas, imperial palaces, metal tools or rice terraces.
scenes.aegean-bronze: Bronze Age Aegean coasts, 2200–1200 BCE. A modest Mediterranean settlement of rubble stone and plaster houses with timber and flat or simple roofs, small protected bay, dry hills, olive trees. Foreground fisherfolk mending nets and loading ceramic jars into a small wooden coastal vessel. Bright clear turquoise water, warm cream stone. No classical Greek marble colonnades, triremes, medieval castles or modern rigging.
scenes.mediterranean-roman-port: Roman Mediterranean coastal towns, 100 BCE–400 CE. A working harbor with brick and plaster warehouses, tiled roofs and distant low hills. Foreground dockworkers roll barrels and carry amphorae, a fish seller and nets at the quay, a modest ancient merchant sailing ship beyond. Soft warm daylight, terracotta and blue sea. Everyday neighborhood rather than famous monuments; no medieval or modern boats.
scenes.europe-early-medieval: Temperate western and eastern European rural villages, 600–1000 CE. Small timber farmsteads with wattle-and-daub walls and thatched gabled roofs along a dirt lane, mixed open fields, broadleaf woodland and a low distant ridge. Foreground sheep and a vegetable garden, people weaving and tending an outdoor cooking fire, timber carts. Cloudy cool morning, fresh greens, brown timber. No Gothic churches, castles, plate armor, windmills or regional flags; architecture typical and unostentatious.
scenes.eastern-mediterranean-medieval: Byzantine and eastern Mediterranean towns, 700–1400 CE. Harbor neighborhood of stone and plaster houses with red tile roofs, modest domed church high in the background, simple masonry walls along a ridge. Foreground fish sellers, baskets and workshop doors, sailors working on a small wooden merchant boat. Blue-gray water, tawny stone, morning sea haze. No famous monument, Ottoman minarets, Gothic castles or fantasy.
scenes.west-asia-medieval: Mesopotamian and neighboring western Asian river towns, 750–1500 CE. Brick and plaster courtyard houses, flat roofs, shaded market awnings, a modest minaret far back, date palms and a broad river. Foreground boat landing with reed and wooden craft, people carrying sacks and selling paper, pottery and cloth beneath shade. Warm dusty ochre, cool river blue, sunlit upper rooftops. No exact Baghdad landmark, fantasy palace, modern items or gigantic dome.
scenes.maghreb-medieval: Northwest African towns and settled foothills, 800–1600 CE. Earthen and stone houses with flat roofs, a plain square minaret on the distant town edge, olive terraces and dry hills against blue sky. Foreground shaded market, baskets, pottery, pack donkeys and a few people tending produce. Warm rose earth, silver olive greens. No specific famous mosque, camels in every street, modern features or desert-only landscape.
scenes.sahel-medieval: Western Sahel and Middle Niger trading settlements, 1000–1700 CE. Broad river landing beneath compact earthen neighborhoods with flat and conical roofs, modest traditional earthen mosque in the far background, surrounding floodplain grasses. Foreground canoe unloading, woven cloth stalls, baskets and people carrying grain. Gold earth, river blue, muted green in bright late-afternoon daylight. Do not copy the modern Great Mosque of Djenne; no giant landmark, colonial buildings or modern objects.
scenes.west-asia-early-modern: Ottoman eastern Mediterranean and Anatolian towns, 1500–1850 CE. A hilly waterfront town with timber upper stories, plaster and stone houses, red tiled roofs, cypresses and modest domes and slender minarets in the far skyline. Foreground bakers selling bread beside an open shop, a produce cart and fishers working with small boats. Clear late afternoon, blue water and warm cream facades. No exact Istanbul landmark, modern steamer or enormous imperial palace.
scenes.korea-medieval-early-modern: Korean villages, 1000–1850 CE. Low village homes mixing tiled roofs and thatched roofs, timber gates and plaster walls, pine-covered mountain ridge above vegetable fields. Foreground domestic courtyard with earthenware storage jars, villagers drying produce, carrying baskets and working beside a modest open workshop. Cool autumn sky, muted greens and warm wood. No Japanese torii, Chinese pagoda, imperial palace, modern wires or text.
scenes.japan-early-modern-town: Japanese towns in the Edo period, 1600–1850 CE. Timber shopfronts with tiled roofs beside a shallow canal, modest wooden bridge, distant low hills and trees. Foreground workers unloading baskets and bundles from a small riverboat, pedestrians with plain umbrellas walking after rain, open shop doorway. Cool overcast light, wet earth and timber, subtle indigo accents. No modern machinery, gigantic castle, readable signage, famous mountain or red torii.
scenes.andes-coastal-medieval: Central Andean coastal settlements, 900–1500 CE, inspired by ordinary Chimu and neighboring coastal communities. Adobe compounds and simple reed roofs against arid tan foothills, narrow irrigated green fields and blue Pacific ocean beyond. Foreground people weaving, shaping pots, drying fishing nets beside small traditional reed fishing craft. Ocean haze, sand beige, muted green and turquoise. No Inca mountain terraces, jungle, colonial architecture or monumental pyramid as main subject.
scenes.caribbean-precontact: Greater Antillean indigenous settlements, 700–1500 CE. Sheltered Caribbean bay below wooded tropical hills, palms and a cluster of round wooden houses with palm-thatched roofs. Foreground household preparing cassava using baskets and a griddle, people carving a dugout canoe and tending food gardens. Bright turquoise water and warm tropical greenery. No European ships or buildings, giant temples, coconuts as main crop, metal tools or generic feathers.
scenes.polynesia-medieval: Tropical Polynesian island communities, 1000–1800 CE. Lagoon beneath a broad volcanic ridge, thatched open-sided houses, breadfruit trees and cultivated inland slopes. Foreground people repairing a wooden outrigger canoe with fiber cordage, woven mats, baskets and small garden beds. Deep blue and turquoise, soft tropical clouds. No European contact goods, tiki theme-park features, Easter Island statues, modern sails or generic ceremonial costumes.
scenes.east-asia-transition-port: Japanese and Korean coastal port neighborhoods, 1870–1910 CE. A working harbor where modest timber and plaster storefronts stand beside simple brick warehouses, telegraph poles and a small distant steamship; forested hills beyond. Foreground handcarts, bicycles, port laborers carrying baskets and crates, mixed plain period work clothes. Cool morning haze and subdued earthy colors. No rickshaw as centerpiece, specific flag, famous landmark, skyscrapers, motorcars or readable writing.
scenes.south-asia-midcentury-town: South Asian small towns, 1945–1980 CE. A lively everyday street of modest plaster and brick shops with shaded verandas, some tiled roofs, distant palms and leafy trees. Foreground bicycle repair stall, tea seller, people carrying market baskets and a modest rounded mid-century bus further down the lane. Monsoon puddles, overcast silver sky, warm faded wall colors. Signs have only indistinct painted shapes and no readable text; no smartphone, skyscraper, neon fantasy or gigantic monument.

scenes.south-asia-early-farming: Early farming communities of the Indian subcontinent, 7000–3500 BCE. A warm river plain with low foothills, small mud and thatch houses, simple cereal plots, cattle, a few goats and woven fences. Foreground households processing grain with stone tools, clay vessels, baskets and a small domestic hearth. Soft dawn, ochre soil and subdued green. scenes.south-asia-bronze-villages: Agricultural settlements of the Indian subcontinent, 3500–1000 BCE. A broad lowland agricultural landscape with a seasonal stream, small rectangular earthen houses and simple thatched shelters, cereal fields and cattle in the distance. Foreground villagers grinding grain, making plain pottery and repairing baskets; modest village lanes and storage jars. Natural warm cream, green and earth colors, overcast bright day. A typical regional farming community rather than an Indus metropolis. No gigantic temple, iron machinery, horse cavalry, modern items, or fantasy.
scenes.northwest-south-asia-antiquity: Northwestern and north-central South Asian settled landscapes, 1000 BCE–500 CE. A mixed farming village and modest market neighborhood of mudbrick and plaster courtyard houses, flat roofs and timber shade, a distant low ridge above fields and a simple irrigation channel. Foreground potter, basket sellers and people milling grain; small cattle cart beside the lane. Warm earth, cream plaster, green fields, soft blue sky. No Mughal dome, minaret, medieval fort, giant temple, European colonial buildings or modern objects.
scenes.southern-south-asia-antiquity: Southern Indian and Sri Lankan agricultural villages, 1000 BCE–500 CE. Small earthen and timber homes with thatched roofs near rice and millet plots, wooded low hills and a modest seasonal stream, palm and broadleaf shade. Foreground people pounding grain, carrying baskets, shaping plain pottery and repairing a fishing net. Fresh green, red-brown earth and hazy morning blue. No giant later temple tower, minaret, colonial house, modern road, steel machinery or New World crops such as maize, chili or tomato.
scenes.northwest-south-asia-medieval: Northern and northwestern South Asian villages and market towns, 500–1500 CE. A modest neighborhood of earthen and plaster courtyard homes, flat roofs, timber verandas and a few simple brick buildings, dry cultivated fields and low hills beyond. Foreground potters, grain sellers and weavers under cloth shade, oxen and a modest cart near the lane. Calm morning, cream walls, earth tones and muted green. scenes.peninsular-south-asia-early-modern: Southern and central Indian and Sri Lankan settled landscapes, 1500–1900 CE. A modest market neighborhood with plaster and brick houses, clay tile and thatch roofs, shaded courtyards, cultivated greenery and a wooded low ridge. Foreground people harvesting and processing rice with stone and wooden tools, plain clay pots, woven baskets and fishing equipment. Humid morning haze, muted jade green and warm earth. Broad loess plain and distant wooded ridge, a cluster of modest rammed-earth houses with simple thatched gables, cereal plots and a dirt lane. Foreground households making pottery, preparing millet, mending baskets and tending pigs; plain timber and stone tools. Warm ochre ground and green fields beneath a soft overcast sky. Ordinary farming community rather than royal capital; no pagoda, monumental bronze vessel, elaborate later roof, imperial palace, wheelbarrow, modern objects or fantasy.
scenes.south-china-medieval: Southern Chinese farming villages and market neighborhoods, 500–1500 CE. A humid river valley framed by wooded low mountains, modest timber and plaster houses with gray tile roofs, rice plots and a simple wooden footbridge. Foreground villagers weaving cloth, sorting rice, carrying produce in baskets and tending a small riverboat. Cool morning mist, deep green vegetation and warm pale walls. No famous palace, gigantic pagoda, Japanese torii, modern objects, maize, chili or tomato. Ordinary everyday architecture and work, with no dynasty-specific banner.
scenes.south-china-early-modern: Southern and southwestern Chinese towns and agricultural outskirts, 1500–1900 CE. scenes.central-asian-oasis-later: Central Asian and northeastern Iranian oasis towns, 1100–1900 CE. scenes.northern-eurasia-forest-communities: Northern Eurasian boreal forest camps and riverside communities, broadly suitable from the early Holocene through 1800 CE. A quiet river or lake beneath low wooded ridges, pine and birch forest, modest bark-covered shelters and a few very simple timber huts without glass windows. Foreground small seated groups preparing fish, weaving baskets, repairing a wooden canoe and working hides near a hearth; drying fish on wooden racks.
